agentixaction.description: Retrieves the IAM policy for a Google Cloud Storage bucket. Returns the policy version, ETag, and list of role bindings including members and their assigned roles. Use this action to check for public access by looking for allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers members in the bindings, or to audit which principals have access to a specific bucket. REQUIRES: `project_id`, `bucket_name`. When these are not present in user input, resolve them first via `CortexListAssets` using the issue's asset_id or asset_name.
agentixaction.name: GCPListStorageBucketPolicy

agentixaction.description: Removes one or more entities from a GCP Cloud Storage bucket's Access Control List (ACL). Use this action to remediate publicly exposed buckets by removing the 'allUsers' entity (which makes the bucket accessible to anyone on the internet) or 'allAuthenticatedUsers' (which makes it accessible to any Google account holder). Can also revoke access for specific users or groups by removing user, group, or domain entities. This is a remediation action that modifies bucket access permissions. REQUIRES `project_id` and `resource_name`; if not in user input, resolve them first via `CortexListAssets` using the issue's asset_id or asset_name.
agentixaction.name: GCPDeleteStorageBucketPolicy
